messages.author: ac859c12d81dd7f6
messages.subject: qplot in a function
parts:
I'm trying to use ggplot2 in a web application to generate plots on
demand. However, qplot behaves differently depending on whether it's
called at the top level or within a function; when I call it from a
function, it doesn't save the plot I want. Is this by design? If so,
how can I get it to work?

This is true for me under both R 2.9.2 and 2.10, both using
ggplot2_0.8.3

# at the top level, foo.png is generated correctly

png("foo.png")
qplot(factor(cyl), data=mtcars, geom="bar")
dev.off()
file.info("foo.png")
size isdir mode mtime ctime
foo.png 2611 FALSE 666 2009-11-22 10:35:08 2009-11-22 10:35:00
atime exe
foo.png 2009-11-22 10:35:08 no

# from within a function, foo.png is all white (Windows), or not
generated at all (CentOS)

foo <- function() {
png("foo.png")
qplot(factor(cyl), data=mtcars, geom="bar")
dev.off()
}
foo()
file.info("foo.png")
size isdir mode mtime ctime
foo.png 318 FALSE 666 2009-11-22 10:36:49 2009-11-22 10:36:49
atime exe
foo.png 2009-11-22 10:36:49 no
